class.name: SteamAnalogInput
class.brief_description: An analog action sample from the current Steam Input frame.
class.description: Read these fields from a successful [method SteamController.analog] result. Steam's mode determines whether the vector represents joystick axes, pointer deltas, or another configured source. Values for relative pointer motion can exceed the normalized joystick range.

method.name: get_mode
method.description: Returns Steam's source mode for this sample. Inactive actions return [constant MODE_NONE].

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns Steam's horizontal and vertical values in units appropriate for the source mode. Inactive actions return [code]Vector2.ZERO[/code].

method.name: is_active
method.description: Returns whether Steam reports that the action is available in the active set.

members.member: Read-only active-set availability for this action.
Read-only horizontal and vertical values for the current source mode.
Read-only source mode that describes how to interpret the vector.

constants.constant: Steam reported an unrecognized input source mode.
